headline: A 2021 law requires the VA to set periodic days when anyone can drop off unneeded controlled-substance medications at certain VA facilities.
what_it_does: The law requires the Department of Veterans Affairs to designate set periods when any person may dispose of controlled-substance medications. Disposal is limited to VA medical facilities that have an on-site pharmacy or a physical location used for law enforcement purposes. The VA may also run public information campaigns about these disposal periods.

who_it_affects.group: Veterans and other people who have controlled-substance medications they no longer need
who_it_affects.how: They can dispose of those medications at eligible VA facilities during the designated periods.

who_it_affects.group: VA medical facilities with an on-site pharmacy or a law enforcement location
who_it_affects.how: They must take part in the designated disposal periods and may be used as drop-off sites.
The VA may run public information campaigns that tell people when the disposal periods happen.

when_it_takes_effect: The law was enacted July 29, 2021, but the summary does not give a specific date for the first disposal period.
